authorization.operator: 2026-10-03 grant of Path A and the blueprint executive instructions

pre_registered_gate: G-CAP: min(raw for V<=128) >= 0.80 AND raw(V=512) < 0.80
gate_evaluation: min raw over V<=128 = 0.8789 >= 0.80; raw(512) = 0.5449 < 0.80. Gate fires. NOT post-hoc: G-CAP was fixed in the script docstring before the run.

controls.loosest_point: V=16 ctrl 0.1250 = 2.0x its chance 0.0625, within the 3x gate. 4/32 correct, z=1.46 vs chance, not significant. Small-N noise, recorded for completeness.

MECHANISM_CAVEAT.pre_registered_signature: H_CAP predicted off-diagonal mean |cos| between per-word centroids RISES with V.
MECHANISM_CAVEAT.conclusion: The accuracy fall is REAL and monotone, but it is NOT caused by worsening representation overlap. Two separable facts must be reported together, not merged:
MECHANISM_CAVEAT.fact_1_representation: cross-word overlap is HIGH (~0.343) and CONSTANT in V. For random unit vectors in 32768-d, E|cos| ~ 0.0056. So the codec's distinct words ARE heavily overlapping -- a codec quality property INDEPENDENT of V.
MECHANISM_CAVEAT.fact_2_decision: with constant ~0.343 overlap and V classes, the number of plausible wrong classes grows with V. Accuracy falls as a decision-theoretic capacity effect (more confusers at fixed separation), not as a representational one.
MECHANISM_CAVEAT.what_this_changes: The fix for large-V egress is NOT 'reduce collisions' (they are already constant). It is (a) reduce the constant crosstalk in the code, or (b) decompose the output into small typed manifolds so V stays small. The data already supports (b): raw >= 0.8789 for V <= 128.

raw_vs_actres: actres applies per-template mean subtraction, which requires the TEMPLATE LABEL at inference (oracle). raw is the deployment number. Only raw was used for the gate. actres is reported as an upper bound under oracle assistance, never as a result.

not_interpretable.ARM_H_hopfield: excluded from this sweep by design. At V=512 the A/B gave 3 samples/class (1536 train / 512 classes), which starves a trained arm. Its 0.0029 is UNINTERPRETABLE, not a Hopfield finding. Re-test at 20-50 samples/class before condemning the architecture.

blueprint_relation.supported: the typed-manifold prescription (sec 2.4 item 3). Measured: small typed manifolds reach >= 0.8789; flat 512-way egress falls to 0.5449. Restricting to Boolean flags / validated coordinates / discrete tool IDs is now evidence-backed.
blueprint_relation.rejected: the causal autopsy (sec 1.1, 2.3). The bottleneck was the codec's own encode() hash-filling 8096/8192 rows (HASH_FILL_IS_THE_SNR_DEFECT, 6x), located upstream of the readout.
blueprint_relation.untested: the Hopfield Lexical Snap as the egress mechanism. beta is argmax-invariant (BETA_IS_NOT_THE_SNAP_MECHANISM); beta*=26.10 remains externally asserted, unverified on host.

class: confirms the pre-registered capacity gate while refusing to confirm the mechanism the same gate named
